claims: The Wisconsin Badgers men's hockey team was defeated 2-1 by the Denver Pioneers in the NCAA Frozen Four championship game.
The game took place on Saturday, April 11, 2026.
The game was at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas.
The Wisconsin Badgers took an early 1-0 lead in the first period.
The Wisconsin Badgers allowed two goals in the third period.
The game ended the Wisconsin Badgers men's hockey team's season.
The final score was Denver 2, Wisconsin 1.
Vasily Zelenov scored for Wisconsin at 13:36 in the first period.
The Denver Pioneers won their 11th national championship.
The game was the NCAA title game.
There are no further Wisconsin Badgers men's hockey games tonight or for the remainder of the 2025-2026 season.
